meta.name: azure-enterprise-infra-planner
meta.description: Architect and provision enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions. For cloud architects and platform engineers planning networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-resource topologies with WAF alignment. Generates Bicep or Terraform directly (no azd). WHEN: 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'architect Azure landing zone', 'design hub-spoke network', 'plan multi-region DR topology', 'set up VNets firewalls and private endpoints', 'subscription-scope Bicep deployment', 'Azure Backup for VM workloads'. PREFER azure-prepare FOR app-centric workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据工作负载描述自动设计并生成Azure基础设施代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是云架构师或平台工程师，需要快速规划并部署企业级Azure基础设施
copy.tagline_en: Automatically design and provision Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions

howto.what: 根据工作负载描述规划企业 Azure 基础设施,涵盖网络、身份、安全、合规与多区域拓扑,按 WAF 对齐生成 Bicep 或 Terraform 代码(不使用 azd),并输出部署方案与代码文件。
howto.when: 当用户提到“plan Azure infrastructure”等关键词,或要求设计 hub-spoke 网络、多区域灾备拓扑等时触发。以应用为中心的工作流优先使用 azure-prepare。

say.text: 为这个工作负载设计多区域灾备拓扑并生成 Terraform 代码。
say.note: 输出灾备拓扑与 Terraform 配置。

say.text: 为订阅级部署生成 Bicep 基础架构代码。
say.note: 输出订阅级 Bicep 文件。

howto.what_en: This skill plans enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions, covering networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-region topologies aligned with WAF. It generates Bicep or Terraform code directly (no azd) and outputs deployment plans and code files.
howto.when_en: Triggered by keywords like 'plan Azure infrastructure' or requests to design hub-spoke networks, multi-region DR topologies, etc. For app-centric workflows, prefer azure-prepare.

say_en.text: Plan a hub-spoke network for an Azure landing zone.
say_en.note: Starts the planning flow and outputs a network architecture plan.

say_en.text: Design a multi-region DR topology for this workload and generate Terraform code.
say_en.note: Outputs the DR topology and Terraform configuration.

say_en.text: Generate Bicep infrastructure code for a subscription-scope deployment.
